official_name: System Package Data Exchange (Linux Foundation Project)
notes: Open standards project hosted by the Linux Foundation that maintains the System Package Data Exchange (SPDX) specification for communicating software, AI, and dataset bill-of-materials metadata, licenses, security, and provenance. Standardized internationally as ISO/IEC 5962:2021 (SPDX 2.2.1). For the SPDX specification, RDF/OWL ontology, JSON Schema, and profile element definitions, see secid:reference/spdx.dev/spdx.

data.description: Multi-profile BOM and supply-chain metadata specification (Core, Software, Licensing, Security, Build, AI, Dataset, Lite, SimpleLicensing, ExpandedLicensing) standardized as ISO/IEC 5962. Addressable specification elements and profile classes/properties are indexed under secid:reference/spdx.dev/spdx.
